theory.heading: What AWS Route 53 is
theory.body: AWS Route 53 describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Solutions Architect to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: AWS Route 53 is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why AWS Route 53 matters
theory.body: Without AWS Route 53, systems built with AWS Solutions Architect are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS Route 53 works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS Route 53 follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AWS Route 53.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS Route 53
theory.body: AWS Route 53 offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
